blocks.text: The response to the complaint is immediate and theological: divine punishment was decreed against the slanderers who had mocked the Guru and oppressed the Sikhs. The page makes clear that worldly upheaval is not random but the chosen instrument of that judgment.

From that point the narrative turns to history in motion as the Kabul ruler is driven toward Lahore and Ahmad Shah Abdali advances into Punjab. Lakhpat Rai and Shah Nawaz attempt to work within the Afghan invasion, but the movement of armies now serves a justice they do not control.

The page leads directly toward the fighting around Sirhind. What begins as a decree in the divine court becomes a campaign on the ground, with imperial ambition and retribution converging in the same war.
